pcs.pc_description: inspect the carpet or upholstery for stains and other marks that need to be cleaned
determine the method of cleaning to be performed like using soap and water, chemical treatment etc.
identify the appropriate chemical solution as per the requirement
collect supplies and cleaning equipment required for performing cleaning operation
arrange personal protective gear like masks, cleaning gloves, close toe non-slip footwear, head cover, and goggles
clean and sanitize all equipment before use
remove or rearrange furniture and other items to access all carpeted areas that need to be cleaned
power vacuum the carpeted area/carpet to remove dry soil
mix water and detergents/chemicals/soap in containers as per specifications
treat the carpet using appropriate solutions like stain remover, grit remover, odour remover etc.
leave the solution on the carpet for specified time to loosen the dirt as per SOP
brush/scrub the carpet (use scrubber machine, if required)
clean old, delicate rug by hand to avoid damage
rinse the carpet thoroughly without over wetting the carpet
perform spot cleaning for deep stains using stain removal treatment
use hot water extraction/rotary shampooing techniques if carpet is still not clean
dry the carpet using drying machines
dry dust the furniture to clean the dirt
vacuum the upholstery to remove dust and lint
clean the corners and back of cushioned sofas using hosepipe/dusting brush vacuum cleaners
apply appropriate cleaning agent to remove stains and leave it on the surface as per SOP to remove stubborn stains
use steam vacuum to clean the upholstery
check for any stain or dirt and damage after cleaning the furniture/upholstery
perform another stain treatment on areas, if not completely cleaned during the initial steam vacuuming
inspect the cleaned carpet or upholstery after drying to ensure cleanliness
crop the top of stained areas that cannot be cleaned, as per SOP
carry out minor repairs with a needle and thread to fix frayed edges
apply stain and moth repellent chemicals, if required
apply chemical agents or color seal to lock the color
rake the carpet or upholstery to restore its texture and appearance
apply protective solution and deodorizers
apply stain prevention solution to the furniture/upholstery
reset furniture once cleaning is complete

pcs.pc_description: examine the marble/granite/vitrified tiled surfaces, scaffolding and related installations or structures to be polished
determine the type of surface, e.g. natural marble or cultured marble
assess the type of stain like simple or stubborn
determine the type of treatment required to polish the surface
arrange the required chemicals, tools and equipment for polishing
ensure complete access to the area to be polished by removing all furniture and decorative items
protect walls and built-In furniture as per organizational SOP
place warning signs to prevent entry to the work area
remove any old, cracked, broken and damaged tile using hammer and chisel
clean the marble/granite/wood and vitrified tile with a dry cloth or dust mop to gently remove all dirt, dust and grit
clean the soft stains using appropriate method using water, mild soap, sponge etc.
scrub surface stains with a nylon bristled brush and a non-abrasive cleaner for cultured surfaces as per organizational SOP
prepare the chemical solution for cleaning the stubborn stain as per specification e.g. for marble a mix of hydrogen peroxide, a few drops of ammonia, and some diatomaceous earth
apply the chemical solution suitable for the surface
cover the paste completely with plastic wrap with holes in it
tape the edges and leave it for drying
wipe and clean the chemical solution with a soft cloth
repeat the process if stain remains
apply a thin layer of polish using clean soft cloth and allow it to dry
rinse the surface with warm water, or use soft cloth to clean the surface, as required
wipe the surface gently in a circular motion
spray sealant over the entire surface and leave it on for 15-30 minutes
dry the surface completely using a soft towel
repeat the sealer application process
remove any residual wax or sealant from marble/granite
apply a layer of high-quality stripper to the surface with a solvent-resistant paint brush
wipe with a clean mop/cloth when stripper begins to blister
repeat the wiping process till the bottom layer of wax or sealant is removed
attach the coarsest grit to the sanding machine
ensure clean, cold water is poured over the marble/granite surface as per the SOP
operate the sanding machine side-to-side with two to four passes
mop the surface after sanding
dry the surface using wet/dry vacuum cleaner
repeat the sanding and cleaning process until the grits get less coarse and desired level of polish is achieved
apply appropriate surface paste for a final pass on the surface using the sanding machine
clean the floor thoroughly using soft cloths, mop and wet/dry vacuum after sanding
add a buffer pad to the sanding machine
spray polishing solution on the surface
buff the marble/granite surface with a rotary floor machine till it shines
mop the area to remove any dust/rubble
